mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS applyId, s.std_nm AS studentName, s.std_no AS studentId, a.type_cd AS counselingType, a.method_cd AS counselingMethod, a.stat_cd AS status, a.aply_dttm AS applyDateTime, a.content FROM cnsl_aply a JOIN std_info s ON a.std_no = s.std_no WHERE a.empl_no = #{emplNo} AND DATE(a.aply_dttm) = #{date} ORDER BY a.aply_dttm ASC

SELECT T.date, T.status FROM ( -- 1. 예약(cnsl_aply) 테이블에서 날짜별 상태 조회 SELECT TO_CHAR(a.aply_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", a.stat_cd as "status" FROM cnsl_aply a WHERE a.empl_no = #{emplNo} -- [수정] jdbcType=DATE를 추가하여 타입을 명확히 함 AND a.aply_dttm >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND a.aply_dttm < (#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}::date + interval '1 day')
UNION ALL
-- 2. 예외일정(cnlr_schd) 테이블에서 날짜별 상태 조회 SELECT TO_CHAR(s.day_cd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", 'EXCEPTION' as "status" FROM cnlr_schd s WHERE s.empl_no = #{emplNo} -- [수정] jdbcType=DATE를 추가하여 타입을 명확히 함 AND s.day_cd BETWEEN #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} ) AS T
